Title: Data and AI delivery Lead
Description: Data and AI Delivery Lead We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We're looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you'd make a great addition to our vibrant team. We are seeking an experienced Data and AI Delivery Lead to join our Americas Analytics and AI team. This individual will play a critical role in evolving our data products into AI-ready, agent-compatible assets while working closely with business stakeholders to reimagine processes through the lens of Agentic AI and modern data architectures. At IT DA, our regional data analytics team drives transformative change by bringing together platforms, applications, and solutions into a unified ecosystem. We support business functions across Siemens North America and South America to optimize processes, enable intelligent decision-making, and position the organization for an AI-first future. This role is central to that mission. This position will be based out of our Mexico office, onsite. Key Responsibilities: Lead data and AI delivery by collaborating with technical teams, platform teams, and IT service providers to ensure timely and quality execution of data and AI use case development. Work closely with business stakeholders to understand requirements, reimagine processes with Agentic AI as a core component, and translate business needs into actionable technical specifications. Help business users visualize the art of the possible with data and AI, and support change management to drive adoption of new solutions across functions. Demonstrate a strong understanding of industrial processes (e.g., manufacturing, supply chain, finance, sales operations) to ensure data products are contextually relevant and business-aligned. Break complex business problems into tangible deliverables, associate them with the right technology elements, and plan execution within the Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe). Provide regular updates on individual project status, risks, and outcomes to the PMO and business stakeholders. Evolve existing data products from traditional analytics models into AI-ready, agent-compatible data assets that support Snowflake Cortex, MCP, and agentic workflows. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including citizen developers, nominated coordinators, and IT partners to ensure seamless integration across the analytics ecosystem. You'll win us over by having the following qualifications: Basic Qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field from an accredited university. Minimum of 7 years of experience in data engineering, data product development, or data and AI delivery roles. Strong understanding of modern data architectures including data lakehouse, data mesh, and data-as-a-service patterns. Hands-on experience with Snowflake, SQL or python and data modeling techniques (dimensional, semantic, and AI-ready data structures). Experience with visualization tools such as Tableau and Power BI. Working knowledge of Agile and Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) methodologies. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical business stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications: Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or industrial domain data environments. Knowledge of change management principles and experience driving technology adoption. Strong stakeholder management and the ability to influence without direct authority. Experience working with offshore and nearshore delivery teams in a global organization. Experience with Snowflake Cortex AI, MCP (Model Context Protocol), or agentic AI frameworks. Familiarity with dbt, data pipeline orchestration, and CI/CD for data products. Understanding of AI/ML concepts including RAG, LLMs, semantic search, and AI agents. This is an opportunity for a Data and AI Delivery Lead to shape the future of how data products are designed, built, and consumed across our organization. If you are passionate about combining data architecture with AI innovation and thrive in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, we encourage you to apply. You'll benefit from: Siemens offers a variety of health and wellness benefits to employees. Details regarding our benefits can be found here: https://www.benefitsquickstart.com/siemens/index.html. The pay range for this position is TO BE ADDED. The actual wage offered may be lower or higher depending on budget and candidate experience, knowledge, skills, qualifications, and premium geographic location. Create a better #TomorrowWithUs About Siemens: We are a global technology company focused on industry, infrastructure, transport, and healthcare. From more resource-efficient factories, resilient supply chains, and smarter buildings and grids, to sustainable transportation as well as advanced healthcare, we create technology with purpose adding real value for customers. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion: We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us. Title: GBS Performance Management Analyst
Description: Job Description The Performance Management Analyst will support consistent, timely, and accurate performance management across NOV GBS by: Consolidating and validating service and operational performance data from multiple sources. Supporting KPI and SLA management, reporting standards, and performance tracking. Developing and maintaining dashboards, scorecards, and management reporting. Identifying trends, exceptions, data-quality issues, and potential performance risks. Supporting recurring governance processes and ensuring actions, decisions, escalations, and commitments are tracked through closure. Providing reliable performance information that enables leaders to understand service results and make informed decisions. Responsibilities Coordinate performance data from multiple value streams, delivery locations, managed-service partners, and source systems. Validate data completeness, consistency, and reliability before information is used in dashboards or governance forums. Identify data-quality issues and coordinate resolution with the appropriate owners. Support the development and ongoing maintenance of SLA and KPI definitions, baselines, calculation methodologies, and reporting standards. Analyze captive and managed-service performance against agreed targets and document material deviations. Identify and flag potential performance risks, unusual trends, or significant variances for leadership attention. Prepare and maintain performance dashboards and scorecards for executive, management, center, and operational governance forums. Translate performance data into clear trends, exceptions, and supporting analysis that leaders can use to make decisions. Support reporting automation and process improvements that make recurring performance cycles faster and more reliable. Coordinate governance calendars, meeting preparation, templates, trackers, and recurring reporting requirements. Prepare meeting materials, executive summaries, minutes, action logs, RAID logs, and escalation records. Track actions, decisions, and open commitments through resolution, maintaining clear ownership and due dates. Prepare center-performance materials that bring together service results with agreed site-health indicators. Coordinate inputs from Center Leaders, HR, Service Delivery teams, and other stakeholders to support center-performance reviews. Maintain accurate follow-up actions and decisions from center-performance reviews. Required QUALIFICATIONS Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Analytics, Data/Information Systems, Operations, Engineering, or a related field. 3+ years of experience in performance reporting, service management, business analytics, operational reporting, shared services, PMO, or consulting/professional services. Hands-on experience consolidating and validating data and supporting KPI/SLA reporting. Experience preparing dashboards, scorecards, or similar performance reporting. Experience supporting recurring performance or governance reporting cycles. Strong Excel and data-analysis skills. Strong analytical, organizational, and coordination skills. Strong written and verbal communication skills in English. Ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders and follow actions and commitments through closure. Preferred Prior exposure to a GBS, GCC, Shared Services, or managed-services environment. Experience with Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, or similar BI/reporting tools. Experience preparing executive-level reporting and management presentations. Experience maintaining action trackers, RAID logs, governance materials, and escalation records. Analytics, Lean Six Sigma, ITIL/service-management, or related certification. Experience working with multiple value streams, delivery locations, or service providers.
